citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 10:28 AM on 06
August 2026. The inspectors attempted to contact the licensee by calling the phone number on file, leaving a voicemail,
ringing the doorbell and knocking on the door. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection
is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement
action.
Additional Inspectors:
Makayla Willis, VETERINARY MEDICAL OFFICEREnd Section
